source_clauses: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine, and when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

requirements.statement: The foot pedal must transmit a signal to the machine when pressed.
The foot pedal must return to its resting position on its own every time the user takes their foot off.
The foot pedal must not move when something brushes against it sideways.

scenarios.description: Pressing the foot pedal to send a signal to the machine.
Releasing the foot pedal, expecting it to return to resting position.

freedoms: The request does not specify the type of signal (e.g., electrical, mechanical, pneumatic).
The request does not specify the mechanism for automatic return.
The request does not specify the material or dimensions of the pedal.
The request does not specify the method to prevent sideways movement.
ambiguities: What is meant by 'signal' - could be electrical, pneumatic, or other.
What is meant by 'move' in the sideways context - could mean displacement, tilting, or activation.
What is meant by 'resting position' - is it fully released or a specific position?
The phrase 'when I take my foot off' implies a specific user action, but the condition for returning is clear.
